title: The wall clock firing itself still emits no feed event (emk's second wanted item)
body: emk (closed) asked for three things; rj0 was split out for the stop (item 1) and the pbb interaction (item 3), but item 2 — 'The wall clock firing is a FEED event (and in ticfac status), not only an observation line' — appears in no open tick I could find (7zs is the earlier progress-gap signal, a different thing). With rj0 the stop now lands within one poll of the bound, but the feed still says nothing at the moment the bound fires; worth triaging so the split did not silently drop it.
